paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai a Israel gam a kumpipa a-om louh lai in, Levi chi a mi khat Ephraim tanggam tawp lam ah a-om a, Judah gam a Bethlehem mi mei in anei hi.
heading: Levi mi Leh Amei

paite: Amei in ang a kawm san a, huchi in Judah gam a Bethlehem a apa inn ah ataisan hi. Huai ah kha li tak a-om hi.
Apasal athou a, asikha leh asabiltung nih pi in kamdam in ava khem a, lungkim a pikik nawn tum in ava delhzui hi. Ama'n apa inn ah ana pilut a, apa'n ana muh in ana kipahpih hi.
Asungpa, numei pa'n akiang a om ding in ana khou a; akiang ah ni thum a-om a, ane un adawnkhawm ua, huai ah atung hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani li ni in zingkhang in athou a, amah bel pawt tum in athou hi. Numei pa'n amakpa kiang ah, "Tanghou tawmchik ne in. Na lungtang hihhalh tadih inla, huai khit chiang in na pai na ding," achi hi.
Huchi in atu ua, anih un ane un adawnkhawm uh. Numei pa'n huai mi kiang ah, "Lungkimtak in tuzan giak in, na lungtang nuamsak in," achi hi.
Huai mi bel pawt tum in athou a, himahleh asungpa'n azolzol a, agiak nawnta hi.
Ani nga zingkhangpi in pawt tum in athou hi. Numei pa'n, "Na lungtang hihhalh tadih lechin akei dia, nitak ninem hun tan bek om tadih in," achi hi. Huchi in anih un an anekhawm nawn uhi.

Huai mi bel amei leh asikha toh pawt tum a akisakleh asungpa, numei pa'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, ni leng akaita, tuzan giak nawn mai inla, ni leng tum ding ahita. Hiai ah giak in; na lungtang akipahna ding in. Huchi in zingchiang in zingkhang in na thou dia, inn lam ah na pai mai ding," achi hi.
Himahleh huai mi huai zan giah a-ut kei a, athou a, apawtta hi. Jebus kho zawn atung a, huai tuh Jerusalem khua ahi, sabiltung nih bawlsa api a; amei leng atel hi.
Jebus kho kiang atun un ni akai mahmahta hi. Sikha in apu kiang ah, "Hong pai dih, hiai Jebuste khopi ah i lut mai dia, i giak mai ding," achi hi.
Apu'n akiang ah, "Israel suan hilou namdang khua ah lut lou e. Gibeah kholam i zuan zaw ding," achi hi.
Asikha kiang ah, "Kisa aw, hiai munte akoi zaw hiam i zuan ding. Gibeah ah hiam, Ramah ah hiam i giak ding," achi hi.
Huchi in apai nawn zel ua; Benjaminte Gibeah kho kiang atun un ni atumta hi.
Gibeah a giak ding in alut ua, alut un huai khopi kholak ah atu uh; kuamah zintun ding a-om ngal kei ua.
Ngai in, nitaklam in putek khat lou kuan ahong pai hi. Huai mi bel Ephraim tanggam a mi ahi a, Gibeah a om zual ahi. Amah Benjamin chite lak a ahi.
Akiheileh kholak a mikhualpa amu hi. Putek in, "Koi a hoh ding? Koi a pan a hong pai na hia?" achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Judah gam a Bethlehem a pan Ephraim tang tawp gam lam a hoh tum ka hi uh. Huai a om ka hi, Bethlehem, Judah gam ah ka va hoh a; tu in TOUPA' inn a hoh tum ka hi. Kuamah hon zintun a-om kei hi.
Ka sabiltung ua ding buhpawl leh gan an ka nei uh. Kei leh na sikhanu leh na sikhate kiang a om tangval a ding leng tanghou leh uain a-om lai a, bangmah taksap ka nei kei uh," achi hi.
Putek in, "Lungmuangtak in om in. Na kulna tengteng ke'n ka tum vek ding. Kholak ah zaw giak mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in a-inn ah apilut a, sabiltungte an apia a; akhete uh asil ua, ne in adawn uhi.

Huchi a nuamsa leh kipaktak a a-om lai un, ngai in, huai khua a mi, Belial tapate khenkhat in huai inn ahon umta uh. Kongkhak ahong khen ua; inn neipa putek kiang ah, "Na inn a hong tungpa hon pikhia in, ka kithuahpih ding uh," achi uhi.
Inn neipa akiang uah ava pawt a, akiang uah, "Hilou e, ka unaute aw, hichi tel a gilou zaw hih mahmah kei un. Hiai mi ka mikhual ahi. Hiai thil haihuai hih kei un," achi hi.
"Ngai un, hiai ah ka tanu nungak leh amei a-om uh. Amau ka hon pikhe dia, amaute zahlaksak in na ut-ut uh atung uah hih un. Himahleh hiai mi tung ah zaw hiai thil gilou hih kei un," achi hi.

Himahleh huai mite'n athu azui nuam kei ua, huchi in hiai mi'n amei aman a, akiang uah ava pikhia hi. Amau ana kithuahpih ua, khovak masiah zankhua in apawngsual uhi. Huchi a khua ahong vaktak in, akhah uhi.
Khua ahong vaktak in numei apai a, apu tunnapa inn kongpi bul ah apuk a, khovak nung tan in a-om nilouh hi.
Apu zingsang in ahong thou a, inn kongpite ahong a, pai tum in ava pawt hi. Ngai in, ameinu kongpi bul ah akhutte insung lam nga in ana lum hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Thou in, i pai ding,” achi hi. Himahleh adawng kei. Huchi in asabiltung tung ah akoihtou a; athou a, amun lam ah apaita hi.
A-inn atun in temta ala a, amei asem a, aguhte toh seh sawm-le-nih in asemnen a, Israel gam teng ah akhak vek hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, amu peuhmahte'n, "Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh hichibang thilhih leh muh tutan in a-om ngei nai kei. 'Ngaihtuah unla, kihou unla, na lungsim uh gen un, " achi uhi.
